crossRefs.note: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’
Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.
Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!

translations.web: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
translations.bsb: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
translations.kjv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
translations.asv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
